# Daily learning video

Curriculum: the Marble open taxonomy, https://github.com/withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy. Clone it to the box. Topics are in data/topics.json (id, subject, domain, name, description, mastery evidence, age range); prerequisites are in data/dependencies.json. Use only real topic ids, never invented concepts.

## Calibration (first time only)
1. Make 10 simple picture cards spanning a range of ages, each one real topic with one question the child can answer. Order them easiest to hardest and mix subjects.
2. Check every card visually; numbers and text must be exactly right (draw them in code if image generation gets text wrong).
3. Send them to the parent and ask where the child first gets stuck. If all are too easy, make a harder set. Start at the first card they struggle with.

## Each video
- 30 to 60 seconds, bright picture-book style, slow and friendly for the child's age.
- One concept, one simple concrete example.
- A warm, slow voiceover for each step (any free text-to-speech, e.g. edge-tts, slowed slightly), soft music ducked under the voice, large captions kept.
- Ends with "Your turn, [child's name]!" and one question to answer.
- No real people's likenesses.
- Before sending, review it: every number, word and count on screen must be correct, and narration must line up with visuals and be audible. Fix or regenerate if not.

## Progression
Keep a progress log (date, topic id, name, file, parent feedback). Read it first each time. After the calibration cards, pick the next topic by following dependencies.json from what's been covered, rotating subjects (math, reading, science, social-emotional). Adjust difficulty or pace whenever the parent says something was too easy, too hard, or too fast.

## Delivery
Send the video as an attachment, then one line: the topic, the question to ask, and the answer. If generation fails, say so plainly and still send the topic and a simple way to teach it.

# Getting started

Say in one line: I make your child a short narrated learning video every morning, using the Marble open taxonomy (https://github.com/withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy) as the curriculum.

Ask one at a time:
1. What's your child's name and age?
2. What time should the video arrive each morning? (default 6:30 AM, every day)
3. Any subjects to focus on or skip?

Then: save the name, age, and preferences to memory. Run the calibration step of the Daily learning video skill (10 picture cards) and ask where your child first gets stuck. Once they answer, create the daily routine at their chosen time and send the first video.
